comparison_method: Original image/actual Blender GLB render pixels cropped, bicubic resized to approximately comparable framing, and placed side by side. No generated/retouched replacement pixels.

visual_findings.difference: V7 is flatter and wider across the forehead and mouth. The concept has a domed, rounded head with full lower cheeks and a distinct muzzle.
V7 eyes sit higher and closer together and read more as circular buttons with thin white rims. The front concept shows wider separation and a more vertical oval gaze.
V7 muzzle blends into a broad shallow face plane; nose projection and the lobed round muzzle/ivory jaw volume are weaker than the reference.

At approximately comparable whole-body framing V7 head reads smaller relative to the thick torso; its neck/chest forms a horizontal shelf. The reference has a prominent head and a more distinct rising neck.
V7 lower coil is a compact C and the upper body stretches horizontally. The reference has a flowing S transition and a broader sweeping tail arc.
V7 has sparse rounded rectangular dorsal lobes and limited visible side mane. The reference has larger pointed overlapping flame leaves flowing continuously around the head and spine.
V7 antlers are thinner, straighter and have extra prongs. Three small pointed claws are visible on each V7 paw while two broad blunt toes dominate the concept.

mesh_and_rig_constraints.workflow_choice: Reused the numerical authoring framework and skeletal arrangement while changing geometry parameters; this choice did not sufficiently reconstruct the concept silhouette.
mesh_and_rig_constraints.judgment: The current rig can be repositioned/reweighted. It is not an unavoidable barrier to fidelity.

next_work_judgment: Local eye/horn/toe adjustments are feasible but insufficient for whole-design fidelity. Reconstruct face volume, neck/head-to-body balance and body centreline, then redesign the mane silhouettes and rebind the idle rig. Separate rebuild has NOT started.
